financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Cash received for first closing of sale of SEED Series A-1 Preferred Shares (sale of subsidiary interests). Only the month, February 2025, is stated, so the day is approximated from the first-closing deadline.
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In February 2025, we received approximately $7.35 million in cash as consideration for the first closing of the sale of a portion of our equity interests in SEED
